data.one_liner: Android implementation of the url_launcher plugin for launching URLs.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific platform implementation for the url_launcher plugin, enabling apps to open external URLs, applications, or custom tabs.
use_when: Building a Flutter application targeting Android that needs to open URLs
Developing a federated plugin architecture where Android platform-specific implementations are required
avoid_when: Developing applications that do not target Android
Using url_launcher where you only need standard cross-platform APIs without directly depending on Android-specific platform implementation details
strengths: Automatically included as an endorsed federated plugin via url_launcher
Native Android implementation updated for modern Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin support
weaknesses: Platform-specific to Android, not a standalone cross-platform package
data.setup_notes: Endorsed package; automatically included when using url_launcher.

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the main cross-platform API for launching URLs instead of using platform-specific implementations directly.

alternatives.name: url_launcher_windows
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the Windows-specific implementation of the url_launcher plugin.
